launch_script_findings.finding: scripts/part_a_score_launch.sh runs `score --manifest ... --text-groups ...` directly; score runs the reuse proofs and continues to GPU commands in one call. The 'proof step' named in the commit message of 1b954a6 exists only as the first stage inside `score`. There is no separate proof-only phase (score_reference_proofs(..., write=True)), retained proof record and accepted repricing before GPU work, as board-a-f11-stage condition 5 and its 'Price and stop-and-reprice' ruling require; nothing in the script stops if a proof fails and the price changes.
the re-hash loop skips a missing file (FileNotFoundError -> continue) and does not fail; a deleted delta/increment would pass. It re-hashes delta/increment files only, not variant.json.
the script does not check the manifest sha256 against a frozen value (stage review: 'verify the frozen manifest hash and staged-zoo identity/bytes at scoring launch'), nor --verify-pins HEAD.
the score_launch.json record is written into docs/ (tracked tree) after the clean-tree check; it records GPU name/driver/memory but not GPU UUID, and no proof/reprice record.
